description: Implementation of a service class for reading floating rate data from a database, including methods to retrieve all rates, active rates, specific rate by ID, interest rate periods, and base lending rate, with internal mappers for database result set processing.

classes.name: FloatingRatesReadPlatformServiceImpl
classes.description: Service class implementing methods to read floating rate data from the database.

classes.name: FloatingRateRowMapper
classes.description: RowMapper for mapping result set rows to FloatingRateData objects, with optional rate periods inclusion.

classes.name: FloatingRatePeriodRowMapper
classes.description: RowMapper for mapping result set rows to FloatingRatePeriodData objects.

classes.name: FloatingRateLookupMapper
classes.description: RowMapper for mapping result set rows to basic FloatingRateData objects for lookup purposes.

classes.name: FloatingInterestRatePeriodRowMapper
classes.description: RowMapper for mapping result set rows to InterestRatePeriodData objects.

methods.name: retrieveAll
methods.description: Retrieves all floating rate data entries from the database.

methods.name: retrieveAllActive
methods.description: Retrieves all active floating rate data entries.

methods.name: retrieveLookupActive
methods.description: Retrieves active floating rate data entries for lookup purposes.

methods.name: retrieveOne
methods.description: Retrieves a specific floating rate by its ID.

methods.name: retrieveInterestRatePeriods
methods.description: Retrieves interest rate periods for a given product ID.
